rawMessage: Synergy 12000 multi-frame startup services follow the strict formula: 1x HA124A1#5ZM (First Frame Onsite Startup) + (N-1)x HA124A1#5ZQ (Additional Frame Onsite Startup). For 3 frames: 1x #5ZM + 2x #5ZQ. Never order #5ZM with Remote Startup (#V0F) or duplicate #5ZM across frames.
ruleUpdate: Onsite Frame Startup requires exactly 1x HA124A1#5ZM + (TotalFrames - 1)x HA124A1#5ZQ. Purge all HA124A1#V0F lines when onsite startup is selected.

HPE Synergy quoting requires strict decoupling of two independent service domains: (1) HU4B2A3 — ongoing Point-of-Sale hardware maintenance (3Y Tech Care Basic, 9x5 NBD), decomposed per-subsystem (#WJN Frame, #Z1Q Composer2, #Z1R VC, 0BT7 Compute, 0BU5 Brocade); and (2) HA124A1 — one-time professional deployment/startup services (SOW-scoped). These are NOT interchangeable and must never be conflated in BOQ assembly.
rawMessage: Learning 1 from Synergy BOQ reconciliation: Decoupling POS warranty (HU4B2A3) from professional startup services (HA124A1). Failure to separate causes duplicate charges and CLIC validation errors.

ruleUpdate: Remote startup (HA124A1#V0F) and Onsite startup (HA124A1#5ZM) are mutually exclusive delivery models for Synergy frame deployment. When Onsite is selected, all Remote startup lines MUST be purged to zero. Quoting both simultaneously creates SOW delivery scope conflicts that trigger CLIC Rule 81039677.
rawMessage: Remote (#V0F) and Onsite (#5ZM) startup cannot coexist on the same Synergy frame cluster. Purge #V0F completely when delivering onsite.

ruleUpdate: In multi-icon OCA solutions (Icon Separation mode), CLIC Rule 81039677 ("Installation and Startup must be quoted for ALL frames") attaches its error to Item 0100/01 — the first physical line of the entire solution BOM — even when the root cause is in a completely different icon container (e.g. Synergy Icon #2). Engineers must NEVER modify DL380 server lines to fix this error. Instead, trace to the Synergy icon Services → Lifecycle and fix startup placement and quantities there.
rawMessage: When Rule 81039677 fires against a DL380 line in a hybrid DL380+Synergy solution, the error is cross-icon attributed. Fix in Synergy Icon #2, not in DL380 Icon #1.

ruleUpdate: When applying support services in OCA multi-icon solutions, NEVER check "Apply displayed install/support to all icons inside the solution". Always scope to "inside the Current Icon" only. This prevents Synergy frame support attributes from leaking into ProLiant rack server trees (or vice versa), which corrupts per-icon support decomposition and generates phantom entitlement mismatches.
rawMessage: Icon-level isolation guardrail: Never apply support cross-icon. Keep support scope confined to "inside the Current Icon" in OCA multi-icon solutions.

ruleUpdate: When OCA CLIC Rules 99916598/99916599 persist after correcting support quantities, the stale rules cache must be flushed: (1) Navigate to Icon container level → Services → set Support to "No Support" with TS5 and "Apply to all nodes inside Current Icon" checked → Save; (2) Dismiss advisory warning about minimum service requirement; (3) Re-apply via "Select Your Own" → filter 3 Years → select HU4B2A3 Tech Care Basic; (4) Set Install Level to "No Installation"; (5) Check "Apply displayed Install/Support level to all nodes inside Current Icon" → OK → Save. This forces OCA to regenerate all child support entitlements from scratch.
rawMessage: OCA support cache flush protocol: Toggle No Support → re-apply Select Your Own → 3Y Tech Care Basic to clear stale CLIC rule violations 99916598/99916599.

ruleUpdate: Synergy startup services (HA124A1#5ZM First Frame Onsite, HA124A1#5ZQ Additional Frame Onsite) must be placed ONLY at the Icon #2 container level under Services → Deployment Services → Install-Install and Start Up. They must NEVER be placed locally under individual "Synergy 12000 Frame #N" child items. Duplicate placement between icon container and child frames causes CLIC Rule 81039677 to fire against the first line item (typically DL380) in the solution BOM.
rawMessage: Startup services go at Icon container level only, never inside child frame items. Duplicating at both levels triggers cross-icon CLIC errors.

ruleUpdate: Every HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen12 server (P73282-B21) requires a hardware maintenance support contract. Common customer error: quoting software licenses (P8B31A OneView) while omitting hardware warranty (HU4B2A30C4V 3Y Tech Care Basic at ,509/unit). The BOQ evaluator must flag any DL380 Gen12 config that has 0 support units against N physical servers.
rawMessage: Customer quoted 15x OneView licenses but 0x hardware support for DL380 Gen12 servers. HU4B2A30C4V must be 1:1 with P73282-B21 chassis count.

ruleUpdate: On HPE Synergy 12000 Frames (P51174-B21) populated solely with SY480 Gen12 compute nodes (P68217-B21), selecting Virtual Connect Fibre Channel upgrade licenses (R3P67A FIO LTU or R3P67AAE BTO E-LTU) is strictly forbidden and triggers CLIC Rules 81410905 and 81314323 (UNBUILDABLE CONFIGURATION: OVERRIDE REQUIRES FACTORY APPROVAL). SY480 Gen12 compute nodes route dedicated SAN traffic via Mezzanine 1 (P68131-B21 64Gb FC HBA) directly to Brocade 64Gb FC Switch Modules (P77653-B21) in Bays 1 & 4. Fibre Channel port expansion must be licensed via Brocade 8-port upgrade E-LTU (Q2E58AAE). Virtual Connect SE 100Gb F32 modules (867796-B21) in Bays 3 & 6 are dedicated to 25G/50G/100G Ethernet (via P64724-B21 adapter in Mezzanine 3), with no FCoE path on Gen12.
rawMessage: CLIC Rule 81410905: FC License SKU (R3P67A/R3P67AAE) must not be allowed for selection if Synergy 12000 Frame includes only Synergy 480 Gen12 compute nodes. Virtual Connect is pure Ethernet on Gen12; SAN connectivity is delivered by Brocade 64Gb FC switches (P77653-B21) and Q2E58AAE.
provenanceSources: HPE OCA CLIC Validation Error Rule 81410905

ruleUpdate: R3P67A is a Factory Integrated Option (FIO LTU) ending in 'A', which strictly requires sub-iteming under a factory CTO chassis base (P51174-B21), triggering CLIC Rules 81013168 and 81125904 ('must be ordered as a sub-item to the Base') if quoted standalone. If a customer procurement contract mandates this 32Gb FC license, it CANNOT be fulfilled using R3P67A. It must be ordered as R3P67AAE (BTO Electronic License / E-LTU) placed in a completely separate standalone software quote (new UCID) where no P51174-B21 chassis or Gen12 compute nodes exist, bypassing both Rule 81125904 and Rule 81410905.
rawMessage: R3P67A FIO fails with Rules 81013168 and 81125904 when ordered standalone, and fails with Rule 81410905 when attached to Gen12 frame. Solution: quote R3P67AAE (E-LTU) on a separate software UCID with no frame.
provenanceSources: HPE OCA CLIC Validation Error Rules 81013168 & 81125904

ruleUpdate: When a multi-frame Synergy deployment (e.g. 2 frames, 24 nodes) is partitioned into separate commercial orders (Option B): (1) Order 2 (Frame 2) is structured as a clean hardware clone with zero loose cables, zero loose transceivers, and zero unpack services; (2) Order 1 (Frame 1) hosts a dedicated Adhoc container carrying 100% of all loose physical connectivity for both frames (DAC cables: 487655-B21 10G, 845406-B21 100G; AOC cables: 845410-B21 100G; fiber: QK734A OM4; transceivers: 455883-B21 10G SFP+ SR, 845398-B21 25G SFP28 SR, 841716-B21 40G QSFP+ BiDi) totaling $96,236.00 list; (3) Embedded switch licenses (Q2E58AAE Brocade 8-port upgrade E-LTU) must NEVER be lumped into Adhoc—they must be split evenly inside the physical switch modules (4 in Frame 1, 4 in Frame 2) to preserve 1:1 hardware module licensing integrity; (4) Tech Care Basic support (HU4B2A3) must be preserved 1:1 on both frames ($46,156 each) to satisfy CLIC Rules 99916598/99916599.
rawMessage: Multi-order Synergy split pattern (Option B): Frame 2 is a clean hardware clone with 0 accessories; Frame 1 carries consolidated Adhoc container with all 7 cables/transceivers for both orders ($96,236 list). Brocade Q2E58AAE licenses are split 4-and-4 inside switch modules, and support is 1:1 ($46,156 per frame).
